# The SQL map

<!-- GENERATED by tooling/scripts/gen/sql-map.mjs. Do not edit: regenerate. -->

Every function in the `public` schema, as the migrations leave it: what kind it is, who may call it, and who does.
A **door** runs as its owner and a signed-in person (or anyone) may call it, so it checks who asks itself; a **reader**
runs as the person calling, under their row-level security; **the server's** is granted to the service role alone; a
**computed column** is read as a column of its table; a **trigger** runs on a table's writes. A caller is a module
of the code (`.rpc("…")`, or a `.select("…")` naming a computed column), another function, a trigger, a rule, a table
or view, the clock (a `cron.schedule` in a migration), or a script a person runs. The tables are in
[data-model.md](data-model.md); each function's body, grants and comment in full are in `supabase/schema.sql`.

After a migration: `corepack pnpm gen:schema-snapshot` (with `supabase start` running), then `corepack pnpm
gen:sql-map`. `tests/docs/sql-map.test.mjs` fails when this page is not what the script writes, and when a function
nothing calls is neither named below with why nor dropped.

## How many

| Kind | Functions | Run as their owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| door | 179 | 179 |
| reader | 76 | 0 |
| the server's | 336 | 292 |
| computed column | 3 | 0 |
| trigger | 100 | 70 |
| all | 694 | 541 |

## Called by nothing

No code, function, trigger, rule, clock or script calls these; each stays for the reason given, and one that stops
being read is dropped by a migration.

| Function | Why it stays |
| --- | --- |
| `ai_shadow_agreement` | read by hand to judge the second model against the first (decision 0023, the shadow port), as the service role |
| `ai_usage_month` | a workspace's month of metered use, under its members' row-level security, for the billing page to read; proved by tests/ai/ai-usage.db.test.mjs |
| `conversation_draft_keep` | Ask's reply draft as decision 0071 first kept it, superseded by conversation_draft_write (00538) and kept for a dashboard a deploy behind; tests/need-you/reply-drafts.db.test.mjs still proves its fence: dropped with that test, in a change of its own |
| `page_freshness` | read by hand: docs/runbook.md, what tabs could not hear or read, `select * from page_freshness(7)` as the service role |
| `platform_admin_add` | an operator adds the Console's staff by hand, as the service role: deliberately not reachable from the app (00467, decision 0066) |
| `platform_role` | the Console's role for the calling session (decision 0066), answered only past the second factor; proved by tests/console/console.db.test.mjs |
| `resume_email_offers` | the back office turns a workspace's offers by email back on by hand once its list is fixed; the notice that stopped them says the statement (apps/edge/lib/email/offer-gates.ts) |
| `sweep_schedules` | read by hand and by the sweep-health suites: every sweep's schedule as pg_cron holds it (00019) |
| `workspace_days` | a member's rolled days of their own workspace (K10), for the back office's member view; proved by its database test |
